margen.superficie: the unlit plaster wall of the meeting room, its trowel marks still visible

escena: SCENE (working through a problem, meeting room in Santiago, evening): both wear the Efeonce team bomber jacket — navy, its ribbed collar and cuffs clearly legible, the register of an important instance. THE LEFT CHEST OF EACH IS VISIBLE AND LIT, turned towards the lens, so the small embroidered emblem reads on both jackets at its real scale; neither chest is covered by an arm. The camera sits IN THE SPACE BETWEEN them: he is at the RIGHT edge of the frame and she further right, both cut by the frame, and NEITHER looks at the camera — they look ACROSS it at each other. The reserved plaster wall runs down the LEFT side, unbroken and in its own shadow, nothing crossing it. An AZURE-BLUE wall screen behind them edges both figures. Caught AT THE INSTANT he stops speaking and she draws breath. 35mm at f/2.8.

lecho.objeto: the out-of-focus edge of the table right against the lens, unlit
